notes: §1985:VIII.2.3.2 is the closed format of the relative file control entry: SELECT [OPTIONAL], a required ASSIGN, RESERVE, "[ ORGANIZATION IS ] RELATIVE", an ACCESS MODE clause that carries RELATIVE KEY as its own phrase (optional after SEQUENTIAL, required after RANDOM or DYNAMIC) and FILE STATUS. The superset rule fileControlClauses parses every clause of every edition and the 1985 shape is restored after it: RequiredClauses refuses an entry with no ASSIGN (COBOL5701), the SR-12.4.5.2-10 row of Rules refuses RANDOM or DYNAMIC with no RELATIVE KEY (COBOL0863, the witness), VisitRelativeKeyClause refuses at 85 a RELATIVE KEY that does not directly follow the ACCESS MODE clause (COBOL0900; probed with no ACCESS MODE, before it, and separated from it by FILE STATUS), the 2002 gates refuse ASSIGN USING, LOCK MODE and SHARING, a repeated clause is COBOL2423, and a RECORD KEY or RECORD DELIMITER clause on the relative file is refused by the format rows of Rules. One clause escapes: paddingCharacterClause is parsed at 85 and EntryClauses, the table of the clauses that belong to one organization's format, has no row for it, so PADDING CHARACTER on a relative file (and on an indexed file) compiles with no diagnostic, where the 1985 clause belongs to the sequential entry alone (§1985:VII.2.7.1 "block padding on sequential files"). A list of two or more ASSIGN operands is refused with COBOL2256 under the implementor's rules that §1985:VIII.2.3.3 SR3 allows.

next.reason: §1985:VIII.2.3.2, the relative file control entry, nests RELATIVE KEY inside the ACCESS MODE clause: optional after SEQUENTIAL, required after RANDOM or DYNAMIC, impossible when ACCESS MODE is omitted. Its 2023 counterpart is §2023:12.4.5.1 'Format 2 (relative)', which §2023:12.4.5.2 SR9 ('Format 2 shall be specified only for a relative file') and §2023:12.4.5.3 GR7 ('The relative format defines a file connector for a relative file') tie to relative files; it makes RELATIVE KEY a clause of its own (§2023:12.4.5.13.2), still required for random and dynamic access by §2023:12.4.5.2 SR10 ('The RELATIVE clause shall be specified if the DYNAMIC or RANDOM phrase of the ACCESS clause is specified'), so every 1985 entry is accepted with the same meaning. But RELATIVE KEY may now be written with ACCESS MODE omitted, and ASSIGN USING, LOCK MODE and SHARING are added, all refused by the 1985 format: wider, compile-time only, CHANGED. The clauses written in line are restated by their own formats, which state part of the entry's syntax: §2023:12.4.5.5.1 (ACCESS MODE), §2023:12.4.5.8.2 (FILE STATUS), §2023:12.4.5.10.2 (ORGANIZATION), §2023:12.4.5.14.2 (RESERVE).
